scope: T-044-50 - committed security verdict evidence for the closure PR head (CI security-verdict-gate); live-tree placement because specs/_archive is FROZEN - the next release's archive sweep git-mv's it to join its siblings

findings.message: The prescription was followed without drift, and the fix is a deletion: the ACTIVE.md read is gone, evidence resolves by artifact over both trees, RELEASE_ID is an optional narrowing that can no longer error the gate.
findings.detail_md:
Point-by-point against the prescription I filed with the HIGH finding:

| prescribed | delivered |
|---|---|
| delete the ACTIVE.md read | the whole `sed … ACTIVE.md` resolution block is removed |
| glob both trees | `shopt -s nullglob` around a `CANDIDATES=(specs/releases/${RELEASE_GLOB}/verdicts/*.handoff.json specs/_archive/releases/${RELEASE_GLOB}/verdicts/*.handoff.json)` array, `shopt -u` immediately after |
| RELEASE_ID optional narrowing, never an error | `RELEASE_GLOB='*'` by default; an id is canon-checked only when supplied and non-`none`, and `none` degrades to the glob instead of failing |
| widen the drift exemption | `specs/releases/*/verdicts/*|specs/_archive/releases/*/verdicts/*` — **narrowly**, not `specs/_archive/**`, so an archived non-verdict change still disqualifies |
| keep fail-closed | empty candidate array → `::error::` + exit 1, naming both expected shapes |

No drift in either direction: nothing extra was added, and the release-id canon (the F-2 hardening) still guards the one place an id reaches a path.

Source-level survivors confirmed at named lines: the 40-hex predicate (`:130`), `--` end-of-options on all three git calls (`:135`, `:140`, `:154`), and the F-2 diff exit-status capture (`:154`). `nullglob` is scoped to the array build only.

verdict_reason: APPROVED covering dfa2e95e. The delta is two commits and three files — the verdict-gate script, its wiring tests and the two ledger events — with no file under dadaia_workspace/ and a clean sweep (0 secret shapes, 0 home paths, 0 skip/xfail; 33 tests green; push-gate exit 0 with zero offenders). The fix is my own prescription without drift, and it is a deletion rather than an addition: the ACTIVE.md read is gone, evidence is resolved by artifact over the live AND archived verdicts trees, RELEASE_ID survives only as an optional narrowing that can no longer error the gate, and the drift exemption is widened narrowly enough that an archived NON-verdict change still disqualifies.
